title: Cosmos Club tied to a UFO crash

tellings.quote: And then you hear of things like the Cosmo Club, you know, had to do with UFO crash.

plain: The Cosmos Club, a private club in Washington, DC, had something to do with a UFO crash, Michels says. He mentions it only in passing, as something "you hear of," and credits it to a researcher who goes by the name Dark Journalist, without saying what the connection was.
